g1_1_business.what_it_does: Granules operates as a vertically integrated pharmaceutical manufacturing company focused on core APIs, PFIs, and Finished Dosages. Its core strategy relies on high volume, low margin scale economies.
competitive_advantage: High volume, low margin scale economies
Consistent track record of delivering margins over the last 10 years

drivers.title: Block 4 Commissioning
drivers.fact: Granules commissioned Block 4, increasing API capacity by 2,500 MT.
drivers.why_it_matters: Higher production capacity supports future volume growth and drives operating leverage.
drivers.evidence_quote: Vizag Block 4 API Facility (Capacity: 2,500 MT, Status: Commissioned)

drivers.title: Oncology Portfolio Expansion
drivers.fact: The company is expanding its portfolio into higher margin oncology APIs.
drivers.why_it_matters: Moving up the value chain from basic APIs (like Paracetamol) to complex oncology formulations will improve gross margins.
drivers.evidence_quote: Block 4 at Unit-V, Vizag, focusing on Oncology APIs, was successfully commissioned.

drivers.title: US Generic Pipeline
drivers.fact: Accelerating ANDA approvals and new finished dosage launches in the high-margin North American market.
drivers.why_it_matters: The US market offers higher realization per unit compared to the ROW markets.
drivers.evidence_quote: We have 14 new product launches planned for the US market over the next 12 months.

drivers.title: 20% CAGR Target
drivers.fact: Management expects to grow at a 20%+ CAGR for the next three years.
drivers.why_it_matters: Provides high visibility into the revenue trajectory over the medium term.
drivers.evidence_quote: Management has explicitly stated they are expected to grow at 20%+ CAGR for the next three years.
